summary: Microsoft beat after the close on 28 Oct: revenue $92.3B (+19%, vs $90.7B est), EPS $4.89 vs ~$4.72, Azure +48% to $33.2B, Microsoft Cloud $63.9B, guidance for 49-50% Azure growth, capex $39.4B. Shares up ~4-5% after hours. Watch: capex worries and 60k-employee buyout headlines.
